Core API#

Design-matrix and spherical harmonic basis routines for geomagnetism.

shgeomag.core.design_matrix.build_design_matrix(gc_lat_rad: ndarray, lon_rad: ndarray, r_km: ndarray, n_max: int, n_truncate: int | None = None, a_ref: float = 6371.2) → ndarray[source]#

Build vectorized design matrix mapping coefficients to [Br, Btheta, Bphi].

Parameters:

  • gc_lat_rad (ndarray) – Geocentric latitude in radians.

  • lon_rad (ndarray) – Geocentric longitude in radians.

  • r_km (ndarray) – Geocentric radius in km.

  • n_max (int) – Model maximum degree.

  • n_truncate (int, optional) – Active truncation degree, default n_max.

  • a_ref (float, default=6371.2) – Reference radius in km.

Returns:

Matrix with shape (3*N, n_truncate*(n_truncate+2)).

Return type:

ndarray

Notes

Implements partial derivatives of spherical harmonic field components from V(r, theta, phi) = a * sum_n (a/r)^(n+1) * sum_m (g cos(m phi) + h sin(m phi)) P_n^m.

Geomagnetic field evaluation routines for spherical and geodetic outputs.

  • year (float) – Decimal year.

Returns:

(F, D, I) where F is nT and D/I are degrees.

Return type:

tuple of ndarray

shgeomag.core.field.compute_sph(model, gc_lat_deg, lon_deg, r_km, year: float) → tuple[ndarray, ndarray, ndarray][source]#

Compute spherical field components (Br, Btheta, Bphi) in nT.

Parameters:

  • model (GeomagModel) – Geomagnetic model object.

  • gc_lat_deg (float or ndarray) – Geocentric latitude in degrees.

  • lon_deg (float or ndarray) – Geocentric longitude in degrees.

  • r_km (float or ndarray) – Geocentric radius in km.

  • year (float) – Decimal year.

Returns:

(Br, Btheta, Bphi) where Br is outward, Btheta southward, Bphi eastward.

Return type:

tuple of ndarray

Rotation utilities between geocentric spherical and geodetic NED frames.

shgeomag.core.rotation.rotate_sph_to_geodetic_ned(br: ndarray, btheta: ndarray, bphi: ndarray, gc_lat_deg: ndarray, gd_lat_deg: ndarray) → tuple[ndarray, ndarray, ndarray][source]#

Rotate spherical field components to geodetic NED components.

Parameters:

  • br (ndarray) – Spherical components in nT, with br outward, btheta southward, and bphi eastward.

  • btheta (ndarray) – Spherical components in nT, with br outward, btheta southward, and bphi eastward.

  • bphi (ndarray) – Spherical components in nT, with br outward, btheta southward, and bphi eastward.

  • gc_lat_deg (ndarray) – Geocentric latitude in degrees.

  • gd_lat_deg (ndarray) – Geodetic latitude in degrees.

Returns:

(X, Y, Z) where X is North, Y is East, Z is Down in nT.

Return type:

tuple of ndarray

Notes

Uses psi = phi_d - phi_c and X = -Btheta * cos(psi) - Br * sin(psi), Y = Bphi, Z = Btheta * sin(psi) - Br * cos(psi).
